title: Test representative tunnel load and reconnect on VPS
description: Exercise representative existing tunnel methods or safe fixtures under the agreed load and failure/reconnect conditions on the approved VPS.
acceptanceCriteria: Each method has a documented evidence level: real VPS, controlled fixture, builder-only, or blocked
Representative load includes start/stop/status/reconnect and records latency, retries, failures, and cleanup
No tight retry loop, orphan process, unbounded memory, or false running state is observed
Any method that cannot be safely run is explicitly blocked/waived rather than marked passed

steps.details: Map the nine methods to approved disposable nodes/endpoints; avoid real production credentials and document unavailable methods.
Set fixed request/process counts, concurrency, duration, and failure injection/reconnect criteria before running.
Execute the matrix, collect process/resource/state/retry evidence, and stop/clean all fixtures.
For any failure, follow root-cause investigation, add a regression test before a fix, and rerun the smallest relevant workload.
Write sanitized `.agent/evidence/task-65-tunnel-traffic.md` with host, method coverage, measurements, and blockers.

technicalNotes: A real tunnel load test can affect external services; use disposable endpoints and approved test nodes only.
